Return expected ODM product paths

Source: R/products.R
odm_product_paths.Rd

Covers both the 3D texturing folder (odm_texturing/, produced when --fast-orthophoto is off) and the 2.5D fallback (odm_texturing_25d/). Use pick_best_textured_obj() / pick_best_textured_glb() to choose whichever variant actually exists on disk.

Usage

odm_product_paths(project)

Arguments

project

A dronebio_project object.

Value

Named character vector of expected product paths.

Examples

project <- dronebio_project(project_dir = tempdir())
odm_product_paths(project)
